remarks: In-town Oasis! Expanded 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath cape on private, professionally landscaped property. Renovated for today's lifestyle with generous room sizes and an open floor plan. Vaulted ceiling family room features a brick fireplace and French doors opening to an extensive terrace w/spa tub and outdoor shower. Brand new designer kitchen with quartz counters, Wolf range, Subzero refrigerators, Bosch dishwasher. Formal living room with fireplace and French doors opening to terrace. Master suite features a spa bath with radiant heat floors, steam shower, whirlpool tub & walk-in closet. 4th bedroom or in-home office with built-ins. 2 car garage and state of the art recessed lighting & sound system inside & out! Enjoy being in the heart of town on this sought-after street. Walking distance to schools, park, restaurants and more. Move-in ready in the heart of New Canaan!
